summary: Point governance identifiers at the live host

delivery.outcome: Every governance identifier this standard publishes names the live host, so adopting repositories stop hand-editing files their adoption lock hashes
nonGoals: No change to governance semantics, diagnostics, gates or ticket rules
No release; publishing a new adoptable revision stays with the owner
No edit inside an adopting repository; those move by re-adoption, not by hand
No acceptance of two predicate types at once; one exact value stays enforced

architecture.decision: Rename the two schema identifiers and the attestation predicate type together in one revision, because manifest.schema.json pins the predicate as a const and a partial rename would make every adopting manifest schema-invalid
interfaceChanges: signedAttestationPredicateType moves to the live host in the same revision as its schema const
architecture.rollback: Revert this ticket before any repository re-adopts; adopted repositories are unaffected until they upgrade

commands: grep -rn 'wellmanifest\.dev' --exclude-dir=.git governance scripts tests POLICY.md docs
validation.evidence: No governance identifier still names the retired host
The governance validator suite passes with the renamed predicate type
The hub gate passes with the change resolving to exactly one governance ticket
